resources.string: Listener: adb forward tcp:%1$d, localabstract:%2$s, then http://127.0.0.1:%1$d
Off by default. When on, and while wireless debugging is on, this phone accepts HTTPS on the local network and advertises itself.
Turn on wireless debugging before HTTPS.

Put the computer on the same Wi-Fi as this phone, tap Pair a computer, and open the address shown in a browser on the computer. The browser will warn that the connection is not private because the phone uses its own certificate; choose Advanced, then continue. Enter a name for the computer and tap Allow here. The page then shows the address and token to give your API client or AI agent.
Connect this phone to Wi-Fi or Ethernet to pair a computer from a browser.
Open this address on the computer. Pairing closes in %1$d:%2$02d, or when you leave this screen.
\"%1$s\" at %2$s will be able to see this phone\'s screen and control it until you revoke it.
Turn on Developer options first: in Settings, open About phone and tap Build number seven times.
